items.reason: Describes the same predictable OAuth state derived from pipeline view names, allowing account substitution instead of providing per-attempt CSRF protection.
Describes the same unchecked sender metadata lookup that raises KeyError for integrations created without sender metadata.
Describes the same missing-Integration branch advancing the pipeline without verifying ownership of the supplied installation ID.
Describes the same unguarded token exchange request causing GitHub HTTP or transport failures to surface as unhandled exceptions.
Describes the same unconditional sender/login metadata lookup causing KeyError when an existing integration lacks sender metadata.
Describes the same translation extraction failure from translating error_short dynamically while leaving default and call-site literals unmarked.
Describes the same incorrect OAuth state in test_installation_not_found, causing the test to pass on state rejection without exercising missing-installation handling.
Describes the same static, predictable pipeline signature used as OAuth state instead of a random per-attempt nonce.
